current_activity: first combat: crosses the Meurthe toward Raon-l'Étape
notes: Event date: 12 November 1944 (Riviera p387: Brooks directed the 100th Division on 12 November to proceed immediately across the Meurthe against Raon-l'Étape; p391: the 100th and 103d Divisions were "entering combat for the first time"). Event definition: the 100th Division, just landed at Marseille (atlas 20 October), starts the VI Corps' preliminary attacks; the date is the order to cross, and the first contact may be a day or two later. Relationship: VI Corps, Seventh Army and 6th Army Group (CMH table, from 1 November). Location: Division command post at Sainte-Barbe on 11 November (atlas), the day before; Baccarat on 14 November. Coordinates: Wikipedia (fr): Baccarat. Event support: moderate (an order date; actual first contact not dated in the page read). Location support: moderate (command post listed one day earlier).
